common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: the interior of a space-station compartment in microgravity.

common_intent_requirements.text: 一只手轻推悬着的小球
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 一只手轻推悬着的小球
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: One small ball initially floats nearly still relative to the cabin, with clear space between it and the floor and walls. A hand approaches, makes gentle contact, and gives the ball a small push.

common_intent_requirements.text: 小球离手后沿推的方向缓慢漂移
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 小球离手后沿推的方向缓慢漂移
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: After separation, the same ball slowly drifts onward in the direction of the push.
The ball remains suspended clear of the cabin surfaces through the end, without curving downward toward the floor.

physics_checks.criterion: 推动发生后小球在微重力设定下继续漂移。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 手球接触后分离，小球向推动方向移动，离开支撑面。
fail_examples: 未有接触就突然向反方向高速飞走
离手后强行加入明显地球重力落地
需要持续托着才能移动
not_required: 不要求严格恒速或精确直线
允许细微空气阻力或姿态旋转

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
